resources.string: The water the fountain holds. Top it up when the fountain says it is low.
The filter cartridge, by what is left of it. Replace it when it runs out, then reset its counter.
The pump that keeps the water moving. In smart mode it rests between runs, so stopped is not a fault.
The battery of this cordless fountain. Charge it when it runs low.
The tray the pets drink from. Empty and clean it when it is full, then put it back.
The tank of clean water that refills the tray. Fill it and put it back.
The tank the used water drains into. Empty it and put it back.
